work.title: Price of Anarchy in Congestion Games with Priorities

claims.label: Theorem 5
claims.gist: The price of anarchy is at most 5/2 with priorities.
claims.statement: For congestion games with affine costs and priority classes, the pure price of anarchy is at most 5/2.

result.summary: No instance above 5/2 among those checked; the proof read line by line.
result.search_scope: Games with up to four players and three resources, affine costs with integer coefficients up to 4.
result.limits: Tightness of the bound was not examined.
